subject: ALDI raw93/raw94 reconciliation and national AC/DC direct tariff scope

evidence.interpretation: ALDI France presents charging prices by connector current type (AC versus DC), not by power tranche. Power values shown with illustrations describe equipment, not tariff eligibility thresholds.
evidence.roamingSeparation: ALDI explicitly distinguishes the final price that can vary when a mobility badge/provider is used; this roaming/eMSP layer is not the CPO-direct tariff.
evidence.applicability: Apply 0.29 EUR/kWh to ALDI-operated FR*ALN AC connectors and 0.35 EUR/kWh to ALDI-operated FR*ALN DC connectors regardless of connector power. Do not apply to ALDI-branded sites physically operated by another CPO.

lineage.reconciliation: Both historical legal/regional ALDI occurrences resolve to the same national FR*ALN tariff authority; raw94 is retained as a non-counting historical alias rather than a second CPO authority.

aliasesResolved: ALDI MARCHE BOIS-GRENIER SARL | raw rank93 -> ALDI France | FR*ALN
ALDI MARCHE SARL (LYO) | raw rank94 -> ALDI France | FR*ALN (same national tariff authority; non-counting)

safeguards: No power-band extrapolation: rule is AC/DC.
No tariff inheritance to third-party-operated ALDI-branded sites.
Electra/Electroverse remain fallback only and are not direct-tariff evidence.
